description: LMF regression (UDP-T3932–UDP-T3940). Override dealers via LMF_AUTHORISED_DEALER / LMF_UNAUTHORISED_DEALER env.

lmfZeroConfigured.note: Open SQ via Finance Lease product dialog (not CSA). FL program with LMF 0.00 on QAT for Armstrong Prestige - Audi.

quickQuote.note: QQ Create Quote lands on Webform (Waive LMF hidden). Re-select standardQuoteProgram on SQ for authorised waive UI.

withLmf.note: FIS AF Program Setup with LMF > 0. Override TL_LMF_PRODUCT / TL_LMF_PROGRAM on SIT if needed.

withoutLmf.note: No LMF in FIS AF — row absent or $0.00. Override TL_NO_LMF_PRODUCT / TL_NO_LMF_PROGRAM.
